        NOVEL,
        POETRY,
        SCIENCE
    }

    internal interface Priced
    {
        int price();
    }

    internal abstract class Item : Priced, IComparable<Item>
    {
        protected internal string title;
        internal static int created;

        internal Item(string title)
        {
            this.title = title;
            created++;
        }

        internal abstract string kind();

        public virtual int CompareTo(Item o)
        {
            return JavaRt.CompareTo(title, o.title);
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return JavaRt.Str(kind()) + ":" + JavaRt.Str(title);
        }

        public abstract int price();
    }

    internal class Book : Item
    {
        internal Genre genre;
        internal int pages;

        internal Book(string title, Genre genre, int pages) : base(title)
        {
            this.genre = genre;
            this.pages = pages;
        }

        internal override string kind()
        {
            return "book";
        }

        public override int price()
        {
            return 500 + pages * 3;
        }

        public override bool Equals(object o)
        {
            return o is Book && ((Book)o).title.Equals(title) && ((Book)o).pages == pages;
        }

        public override int GetHashCode()
        {
            return JavaRt.HashCode(title) * 31 + pages;
        }
    }

    internal class Magazine : Item

        internal int issue;

        internal Magazine(string title, int issue) : base(title)
        {
            this.issue = issue;
        }

        internal override string kind()
        {
            return "magazine";
        }

        public override int price()
        {
            return 250;
        }

        public override string ToString()
        {
            return JavaRt.Str(base.ToString()) + "#" + issue;
        }

    internal static List<T> filter<T>(List<T> xs, Func<T, bool> keep)
    {
        List<T> @out = new List<T>();
        foreach (T x in xs)
        {
            if (keep(x))
            {
                @out.Add(x);
            }
        }
        return @out;
    }

    internal static List<R> map<T, R>(List<T> xs, Func<T, R> f)
    {
        List<R> @out = new List<R>();
        foreach (T x in xs)
        {
            @out.Add(f(x));
        }
        return @out;
    }

    internal static int category(string word)
    {
        int score = 0;
        switch (word)
        {
            case "alpha":
                score += 1;
                goto case "beta";
            case "beta":
                score += 10;
                break;
            case "gamma":
                score = -1;
                break;
            default:
                score = 100;
                break;
        }
        return score;
    }

    internal static int findPair(int[][] grid, int target)
    {
        int found = -1;
        for (int r = 0; r < grid.Length; r++)
        {
            for (int c = 0; c < grid[r].Length; c++)
            {
                if (grid[r][c] < 0)
                {
                    goto outer_continue;
                }
                if (grid[r][c] == target)
                {
                    found = r * 10 + c;
                    goto outer_break;
                }
            }
        outer_continue:;
        }
        outer_break:;
        return found;
    }
